preconditions.expression: 1 <= N <= 1000 and 1 <= KnightPos[0] <= N and 1 <= KnightPos[1] <= N and 1 <= TargetPos[0] <= N and 1 <= TargetPos[1] <= N
preconditions.description: The chessboard size N is between 1 and 1000, and both the initial and target positions of the knight are within the bounds of the chessboard.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if the target cannot be reached, or a positive integer representing the minimum number of steps the knight must take to reach the target position.
